svg.aria-label: One condition, two commitments: the wallet company. The deciding condition was the licence, controlled by the regulator, not the company. Engineering waited: it kept a modest team rather than building for a scale the regulator had not allowed, which was reasonable at the time, the option value of waiting applied correctly; later, I suspect, the temporary team became load-bearing. Acquisition committed: it spent heavily on deals and discounts to bring users in, spent once, before the deciding condition was met; the licence came after the first wave had passed. Time each commitment by the conditions that decide whether that commitment will produce value.
